method: Read-only web research (consortium, manager and sponsor sites; ATI awards page https://www.ati.org/rd-project-awards/). No SAM.gov notices opened. 'secondary' = search snippet or aggregator. Baseline: MITRE AiDA consortia table, updated 2024-04-23.

rows.name: DoD Ordnance Technology Consortium (DOTC), with the National Armaments Consortium
rows.claim: DOTC (DoD Ordnance Technology Consortium, OSD-sponsored, used by all Services) is issuing project awards.

sources.evidence: ATI DOTC page (dated 2026-04-06): OSD sponsor, used by all Services.
Latest DOTC award listed 10/30/2026 (Polymer Technologies, $672K).
Site live; visible content dated 2023.

rows.notes: Listed sponsor in the Apr 2024 AiDA table: DoD/Army. Manager: NAC Consortium Management Firm (ATI hosts the DOTC page).

rows.name: Construction OTA authority, 10 U.S.C. 2808a
rows.claim: No DoW-wide implementing guidance yet for construction other transactions under 10 U.S.C. 2808a; USACE has published a playbook, 'Executing PDB with OTA'.

sources.evidence: Added by Pub. L. 119-60 §2802 (Dec 18, 2025); applies to transactions on or after enactment.
USACE playbook 'Executing Progressive Design-Build (PDB) with Other Transaction', dated 12 June 2026.
Law-firm note: the DoW Guide to Prototype OTs (Oct 14, 2026) Appendix D 'Construction OT' is a placeholder — secondary.

rows.notes: Supersedes the Holland & Knight Jul 23, 2026 'none issued' wording. An Air Force §2808a PDB OT solicitation is live (91st Cyber Operations Center, W9126G27QA008; secondary). verified=false: the guidance-status evidence is a law-firm note and a search result; only the statute page was opened.
